subject: Re: Fourier robustness heat maps — kickoff
body:
Hi Lucia,

Staffing: Freya 60% (analysis lead), Milan 50% (TensorFlowNeuralNetwork wrappers and batching), Katya 40% (eval sets). Compute: 32 A100s on titan best-effort covers heat map generation.

Data plan: we need our perturbed eval image sets living in Corpus before the v2 migration freeze. Corpus has the freeze landing 2026-07-24, so I am targeting Jul 17 for the last ingestion batch, one week of slack. Katya owns the ingestion pipeline and will version the Fourier basis perturbations alongside the clean sets.

One ask: can you confirm which classifiers count as flagship for the readout? Heat map cost scales linearly with the number of models.

Alina
